hints.tr: `while lo < hi:` içinde `mid = (lo + hi) // 2`; `items[mid] < target` ise `lo = mid + 1`.
hints.en: Inside `while lo < hi:`, `mid = (lo + hi) // 2`; if `items[mid] < target`, `lo = mid + 1`.

hints.tr: Değilse `hi = mid` (mid de aday olabilir); döngü bitince `return lo`.
hints.en: Otherwise `hi = mid` (mid may be the answer too); after the loop `return lo`.

hint.en: Do not use `bisect`; write the binary search yourself.
